items.prompt: An empty, white, featureless room that seems larger than it should be; in the very centre a young woman with red hair sits on a simple stool with her eyes closed and hands on her knees, seen from a distance, an old man standing quietly at the edge of the room.

alt.ru: Большая пустая белая комната; в центре на табурете с закрытыми глазами сидит рыжая девушка, у края комнаты тихо стоит старик.
alt.en: A large, empty white room; in the centre a red-haired young woman sits on a stool with eyes closed, an old man standing quietly at the edge of the room.
alt.pt: Uma sala branca, ampla e vazia; ao centro uma jovem ruiva sentada num banco de olhos fechados, um velho de pé, calado, perto da parede.
alt.es: Una sala blanca, amplia y vacía; en el centro una joven pelirroja sentada en un taburete con los ojos cerrados, un anciano de pie en silencio junto a la pared.
